proposal.observation: Round 1 produced only a small proxy gain (+0.0019): fill rose slightly to 0.7499, while ontology divergence worsened from 0.1015 to 0.1059 and phase incoherence remained 29.2 degrees. Upstream coverage stayed stable, all ten rings were recovered with essentially perfect x spacing, but only half of prompt points came from real detections, midpoint ratio was 0.2, and the detected-line image still contains very few usable oblique joints.
proposal.failure_mode: f_missing_lines: sparse oblique-joint yield is forcing a 50% fallback mixture, leaving circumferential prompt placement weakly constrained despite a correct ring grid.
proposal.rationale: Make the outlier map and fragmented oblique joints easier to detect by moderately lowering the binary and oblique Hough thresholds and increasing the oblique line-gap allowance. This targets the weak real-detection and midpoint evidence while preserving the already-correct vertical ring count and spacing; SAM geometry and unfolding are left unchanged so the round isolates stage-4 prompt evidence.
